specialists.name: Safety rules
specialists.line: Reads every message first. Pain or red flags pause training.

specialists.name: Your topics
specialists.line: Topics you answer yourself, like supplements or medication.

specialists.name: Memory
specialists.line: Reads the intake, the last 28 days of training and the recent chat. Facts from your app only.

specialists.name: Rule finder
specialists.line: Finds which of your approved replies fit, within your limits.

specialists.name: Checker
specialists.line: Checks the answer cites your rule and stays in your limits.

specialists.line: Plans only. Scores each plan in %. Below your bar, it waits.

specialists.name: Lane gate
specialists.line: Sends on its own, waits for you, or pauses.

specialists.line: Applies your recovery rule when a workout starts. Only if you turn it on and the member opts in.
